About Us

Building Brighter Possibilities Together

FlashBit Financing Corp. is a newly registered corporation committed to providing simple, secure, and responsible financing solutions for every Filipino.

More Opportunities
for Every Filipino.

Our Company

FlashBit Financing Corp. (the “Company”) is a newly registered corporation duly organized and existing under the laws of the Philippines. We are operating under the name of Livaya Financing, Alago Financing and Sulivo Financing, offering accessible and responsible financing solutions tailored to the everyday needs of Filipinos.

We leverage technology and customer-centric service to provide a simple and transparent lending experience. Our focus is to promote financial inclusion, support individual and business growth, and contribute to a brighter and more inclusive future for our customers and the communities we serve.

Our Ownership

99.99% owned by Novolink PTE Ltd.

Novolink PTE Ltd. is based in Singapore. It provides FlashBit Financing Corp. with strategic direction, financial support and expertise as the company grows in the Philippines.

Our Purpose and Values

Our purpose is to expand access to responsible financing for Filipinos through practical, technology-enabled services.

  • Customer First

    We build our services around our customers’ everyday needs.

  • Integrity

    We act openly, honestly and ethically.

  • Responsible Lending

    We support fair access to credit and clear borrowing decisions.

  • Innovation

    We use technology to make financing easier to understand and access.

  • Growth Together

    We aim to support the growth of individuals and businesses in the communities we serve.
